source_note: Colour swatches shown on the official BYD Uzbekistan model pages (bydauto.uz), read on 2026-10-10 during Phase 0 research (docs/research/phase0_findings_deploy_market.md, section 9). Each hex value is the colour of the website swatch, which only approximates the real paint. These are not factory paint codes. The name 'Midnight Blue' for the BYD Yuan Up DM-i swatch was inferred from the page text, because the swatch has no label of its own. No Toyota colours are included: the Toyota Central Asia pages had no colour data.
